main_measure.name: mean excess 3-bar return over cases (return minus coin's 3-bar drift), pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and slope > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 3-bar return on post_pipeline_value at case bar

decided_by: The t of the mean excess 3-bar return lies between -2 and 2.
reading: Cases are long-side forecast rises of at least 2 points (from the lowest long level since the last bet, 0 after flat), the first per 3-bar grid cell of each window, dropped when the 3-bar return leaves the window; drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 3-bar return over all its windows.
